text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Speak to all the congregation of the people of Israel and say to them: You shall be holy, for I the Lord your God am holy.
text_cn: “你告诉以色列子民全会众说：你们应该是圣的，因为我，上主，你们的天主是圣的。

text_en: You shall each revere your mother and father, and you shall keep my sabbaths: I am the Lord your God.
text_cn: 你们每人应孝敬母亲和父亲，应遵守我的安息日。我，上主是你们的天主。

text_en: Do not turn to idols or make cast images for yourselves: I am the Lord your God.
text_cn: 你们不要归依偶像，也不要为自己铸造神像：我，上主是你们的天主。

text_en: When you offer a sacrifice of well-being to the Lord , offer it in such a way that it is acceptable in your behalf.
text_cn: 若你们给上主祭献和平祭，要奉献可蒙受悦纳的。

text_en: It shall be eaten on the same day you offer it, or on the next day; and anything left over until the third day shall be consumed in fire.
text_cn: 祭肉，应在你们祭献的当天或第二天吃尽；有剩下的，到第三天应用火烧了。

text_en: If it is eaten at all on the third day, it is an abomination; it will not be acceptable.
text_cn: 若还有人在第三天吃，这肉已不洁，必不蒙悦纳。

text_en: All who eat it shall be subject to punishment, because they have profaned what is holy to the Lord ; and any such person shall be cut off from the people.
text_cn: 那吃的人，必负罪债，因为他亵渎了上主的圣物；这人应由民间铲除。

text_en: When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not reap to the very edges of your field, or gather the gleanings of your harvest.
text_cn: 当你们收割田地的庄稼时，你不可割到地边；收获后剩下的穗子，不可再拾。

text_en: You shall not strip your vineyard bare, or gather the fallen grapes of your vineyard; you shall leave them for the poor and the alien: I am the Lord your God.
text_cn: 葡萄摘后不应去搜；葡萄园内掉下的，不应拾取，应留给穷人和外方人：我，上主是你们的天主。

text_en: You shall not steal; you shall not deal falsely; and you shall not lie to one another.
text_cn: 你们不要偷窃，不要欺诈，不要彼此哄骗；

text_en: And you shall not swear falsely by my name, profaning the name of your God: I am the Lord .
text_cn: 不要奉我的名妄发虚誓，而亵渎你天主的名字：我是上主。

text_en: You shall not defraud your neighbor; you shall not steal; and you shall not keep for yourself the wages of a laborer until morning.
text_cn: 你不要欺压剥削你的近人，佣人的工钱不可在你处过夜，留到第二天早晨。

text_en: You shall not revile the deaf or put a stumbling block before the blind; you shall fear your God: I am the Lord .
text_cn: 不可咒骂聋子；不可将障碍物放在瞎子面前；但应敬畏你的天主：我是上主。

text_en: You shall not render an unjust judgment; you shall not be partial to the poor or defer to the great: with justice you shall judge your neighbor.
text_cn: 审判时，你们不要违背正义；不可袒护穷人，也不可重视有权势的人，只依正义审判你的同胞。

text_en: You shall not go around as a slanderer among your people, and you shall not profit by the blood of your neighbor: I am the Lord .
text_cn: 不可去毁谤你本族人，也不可危害人的性命：我是上主。

text_en: You shall not hate in your heart anyone of your kin; you shall reprove your neighbor, or you will incur guilt yourself.
text_cn: 不可存心怀恨你的兄弟，应坦白劝戒你的同胞，免得为了他而负罪债。

text_en: You shall not take vengeance or bear a grudge against any of your people, but you shall love your neighbor as yourself: I am the Lord .
text_cn: 不可复仇，对你本国人，不可心怀怨恨；但应爱人如己：我是上主。

text_en: You shall keep my statutes. You shall not let your animals breed with a different kind; you shall not sow your field with two kinds of seed; nor shall you put on a garment made of two different materials.
text_cn: 你们应遵守我的法令：不可使你的家畜与不同类的配合；一块田内，不可播上不同的种子；用两种线织成的衣服，不可穿在你的身上。

text_en: If a man has sexual relations with a woman who is a slave, designated for another man but not ransomed or given her freedom, an inquiry shall be held. They shall not be put to death, since she has not been freed;
text_cn: 若人同已许配于人，尚未赎回，或没有获得自由的婢女同寝，应受处罚，但不该死，因为她还没有自由。

text_en: but he shall bring a guilt offering for himself to the Lord , at the entrance of the tent of meeting, a ram as guilt offering.
text_cn: 但是，这人却应把一只赎过祭的公绵羊，牵到会幕门口，献给上主，作为他的赎过祭。

text_en: And the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of guilt offering before the Lord for his sin that he committed; and the sin he committed shall be forgiven him.
text_cn: 司祭用这赎过祭的公绵羊，在上主面前，代他为他所犯的罪行赎罪礼；他犯的罪方可得赦。

text_en: When you come into the land and plant all kinds of trees for food, then you shall regard their fruit as forbidden; three years it shall be forbidden to you, it must not be eaten.
text_cn: 几时你们进了那地方，栽种了什么果树，树上的果子，你们应视为不洁；三年以内为你们算是不洁，不可以吃；

text_en: In the fourth year all their fruit shall be set apart for rejoicing in the Lord .
text_cn: 到第四年，结的一切果实都是圣的，应作赞颂上主的礼品；

text_en: But in the fifth year you may eat of their fruit, that their yield may be increased for you: I am the Lord your God.
text_cn: 到第五年，才可以吃树上结的果实，使树为你们增加出产：我，上主是你们的天主。

text_en: You shall not eat anything with its blood. You shall not practice augury or witchcraft.
text_cn: 你们不可吃任何带血的食物，不可占卜，不可念咒；

text_en: You shall not round off the hair on your temples or mar the edges of your beard.
text_cn: 不可将两边的头发剃圆；两边的胡须，也不可修剪。

text_en: You shall not make any gashes in your flesh for the dead or tattoo any marks upon you: I am the Lord .
text_cn: 不可为死者割伤你们的身体，也不可在你们身上刺花纹：我是上主。

text_en: Do not profane your daughter by making her a prostitute, that the land not become prostituted and full of depravity.
text_cn: 不可亵渎你的女儿，令她卖淫，免得这地方成为淫场，充满淫乱。

text_en: You shall keep my sabbaths and reverence my sanctuary: I am the Lord .
text_cn: 应遵守我的安息日，应敬畏我的圣所：我是上主。

text_en: Do not turn to mediums or wizards; do not seek them out, to be defiled by them: I am the Lord your God.
text_cn: 不可去探询亡魂，亦不可寻问占卜者，而为他们所玷污：我，上主是你们的天主。

text_en: You shall rise before the aged, and defer to the old; and you shall fear your God: I am the Lord .
text_cn: 在白发老人前，应起立；对老年人要尊敬，应敬畏你的天主：我是上主。

text_en: When an alien resides with you in your land, you shall not oppress the alien.
text_cn: 若外方人在你们的地域内，与你住在一起，不可欺压他；

text_en: The alien who resides with you shall be to you as the citizen among you; you shall love the alien as yourself, for you were aliens in the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.
text_cn: 对与你们住在一起的外方人，应看作你们中的一个同乡，爱他如爱你自己，因为你们在埃及地也做过外方人：我，上主是你们的天主。

text_en: You shall not cheat in measuring length, weight, or quantity.
text_cn: 在审断度、量、衡上，不可不公平；

text_en: You shall have honest balances, honest weights, an honest ephah, and an honest hin: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
text_cn: 天平、法码、升、勺，都应正确。我是领你们出离埃及地的上主你们的天主。

text_en: You shall keep all my statutes and all my ordinances, and observe them: I am the Lord .
text_cn: 你们应遵守我的一切法令和我的一切规定，一一依照执行：我是上主。”
